scope: Proposition 11.7 (A robust sign disk) of the manuscript “Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar” (preprints/Rigidity-of-Smooth-Billiards-with-a-Continuous-Caustic-Collar-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fefc18481d52acb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 140. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the deterministic level in Theorem 11.6, put h1 = 1 2Kα/2 , rrob = e−k−h1/4 . (11.24) Outside a set of relative horizontal measure tending to zero on either tested row, each point z has | log |f(ζ)|| ≥ h1 (|ζ − z| ≤ rrob), with constant sign on that disk. In the odd-slice Brownian experiment, for each fixed site the probability that its first hit of the tested shape depth occurs at a point without this property tends to zero.
